title: Stan 1（导入约定待核对）
confirmed_by_user: Only row index 7 is the finger-to-key assignment.
-1 means no key; the always -1 column denotes the wrist.
assumptions_to_verify: Columns 1..5 are thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky.
NPY samples are uniform 0.05 seconds starting at t=0.
limitations: No original Stan MIDI or timing metadata was supplied.
Consecutive equal key assignments are merged; repeated attacks without a release cannot be recovered.
Velocity 80 and no sustain events are placeholders, not measured performance data.
This NPY timeline is not aligned to the nonuniform 793-frame joint trajectory.
